profile.headline: Software Engineer at City of Thornton
profile.summary: Experienced System Analyst with a demonstrated history of working in the government administration industry. Strong information technology professional skilled in Nonprofit Organizations, Analytical Skills, Government, WordPress, and XHTML.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: I use a variety of application development tools, configuration management and version control and testing skills to design, write and maintain software, web applications and databases for city departments.  I discuss and assess end-user needs and requirements in order to analyze and evaluate existing software systems for efficiency and effectiveness, or to diagnose and repair system or programming problems.  I exercise significant discretion and independent judgment in planning, managing, implementing or monitoring multiple data processing projects; develop documentation and provide production support.  I evaluate employee training needs, develop goals, objectives and standards to prepare and present systems and application training.

company.name: National Association of Government Web Professionals

positions.title: Adjunct Professor, Computer Science
positions.description: I teach a variety of university level computer science courses.  I develop syllabi, outlines and lesson plans to help students learn and achieve established course goals and objectives.  I use an assortment of teaching methods such as lecture, presentations, moderated classroom discussions and individual/team projects for classes in basic computer use, programming (C++, C#, VB, etc.), database construction in Microsoft Access, tools and methods of supplication development and testing.  I write vehicles to test and evaluate student progress, help students in understanding difficult concepts, establish deadlines, grade written assignments and projects, and grade students in line with university guidelines.  I maintain office hours to counsel students on academic progress.
